title: Amazon Basics Cotton Balls for Skincare, Makeup Removal, Cotton, Hypoallergenic, 200 Count (Previously Solimo)

reviews.title: Unexpectedly Impressed: A Budget-Friendly Review of Amazon Basics Cotton Balls
reviews.body: I recently purchased the Amazon Basics Cotton Balls, 200ct and I am thoroughly impressed with the quality of these cotton balls. As someone who uses cotton balls regularly for makeup removal, applying toner and other skincare products, I was hesitant to purchase these as they are an Amazon Basics product and I wasn't sure how they would compare to other more expensive cotton balls on the market. However, I am happy to report that these cotton balls are just as good, if not better, than some of the more expensive ones I have used in the past.First and foremost, these cotton balls are incredibly soft and gentle on the skin. They don't leave any scratches or irritations, even when used on sensitive areas around the eyes. They are also very absorbent and hold a good amount of liquid without falling apart or leaving any residue behind. This is particularly important for me when I am using them to apply toner or other skincare products, as I don't want any cotton fibers or debris to be left on my skin.Another thing I really like about these cotton balls is that they come in a convenient resealable bag. This makes it easy to store them and keep them fresh, while also reducing waste. The bag is also a decent size, so it will last me a good while before I need to purchase more.One minor downside to these cotton balls is that they are a bit smaller than some other brands I have used in the past. This isn't a huge issue for me, as I find them to be a good size for most of my needs, but if you prefer larger cotton balls, these might not be the best choice for you.Overall, I would highly recommend the Amazon Basics Cotton Balls, 200ct to anyone looking for a high-quality and affordable option. They are gentle on the skin, absorbent, and come in a convenient resealable bag. They are also a great value for the amount you get in each bag, making them a great choice for anyone who uses cotton balls regularly.
